License: WTFPL, as declared by the upstream Cargo manifest. LICENSE.WTFPL
contains the identical WTFPL v2 text supplied by ffmpeg-next 9.0.0.

rust-VN modifications:
hwcontext_wrapper.h: bind available libavutil hardware-context headers without
generating the full external SDK APIs. CUDA and Direct3D use opaque handles and
integer-width stand-ins. D3D11 is gated on d3d11.h; D3D12 requires all three
Direct3D 12 SDK headers before including its optional hardware context.
MinGW distributions may provide d3d12.h without d3d12video.h, and guard macros
alone cannot prevent Clang from reporting a missing included file.

hwcontext_stubs/: bindgen-only header shims provide the external types referenced
by FFmpeg's Vulkan, VideoToolbox, VAAPI and QSV headers. Handles and pointer-only
structures remain opaque; the shims do not implement these SDKs or enable their
hardware accelerators. Vulkan's embedded-by-value VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2
uses its structural layout and a 240-byte static assertion for the validated
64-bit ABI. build.rs prepends the shim include directory and tracks the wrapper
and shim headers as build inputs. Real SDK headers are deliberately not imported
through those shim paths.

The rust-VN distributed FFmpeg runtime decodes VP8/Vorbis in software and is
built with hardware acceleration disabled. These bindings do not constitute
hardware-decoding or cross-platform SDK qualification. The Linux x86_64 video
build was verified with BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS=--target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
and LIBCLANG_PATH set to the selected LLVM library directory. Bindgen must use
the intended target, not a different default Clang ABI; 32-bit builds are not
qualified by the current Vulkan layout assertion.

build.rs / dynamic_link.rs: on Linux, a dynamic FFMPEG_DIR build links the
exact versioned shared objects selected from that prefix. This prevents a
transitive system-library search path from silently choosing a different
FFmpeg ABI than the headers used to generate bindings. Prefix escapes,
missing and unversioned objects are rejected. Static builds, builds without
FFMPEG_DIR and other target platforms retain upstream link selection.
The helper includes isolated filesystem tests runnable with rustc --test.
